skill: Use Gauss-Jordan row operations on a consistent singular 3x3 system with two pivots to obtain its unique 3x4 augmented RREF; in the solve family express x and y as affine functions of the free variable z and select the corresponding vector.
learner_operation: Read all coefficients and right-hand sides, identify independent rows, normalize pivots and eliminate below/above them, then distinguish the resulting matrix or full solution set from plausible erroneous alternatives.
reasoning_steps: Translate three equations in x,y,z into a 3x4 augmented matrix.
Swap rows if useful; eliminate the first column and find/normalize the second pivot; move the zero row to the bottom.
Clear the entry above the second pivot.
For solve prompts read x=a+bz and y=c+dz with z arbitrary real; select one of five radio choices.
response_contract: Every captured assessed question has one selection radio field with five choices, one correct. Matrix family asks RREF only; solve family asks RREF and general solution but responds with a parameterized column vector.
difficulty: All 17 source questions hard; small signed integer input, sometimes rational row scaling, about 2–6 forward operations plus one backward elimination. Finite real one-parameter solutions.
invariants: Three equations / three real variables; augmented matrix has coefficient rank and augmented rank two.
RREF has two unit pivots, pivot-column zeros, and a bottom zero row.
Keep the two observed response families and their five-choice single-selection contract.
No new nonlinear algebra, determinants, or free-entry construction required.

fixed_features.justification: Target KP specifically two pivots; all 17 source keys are matrix rank two or one-parameter solutions. A No solution choice is a distractor, not grounds to introduce an inconsistent family.

fixed_features.feature: Pivots in x,y and free z for conservative reproduction
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial 3949 specifically clears a12 using row 2; every assessed example uses this arrangement. Other pivot pairs may be same-method extensions but are not necessary to establish varied decisions within this scope.

permitted_variations: Independently vary signed coefficients, constants, and resulting free-column slopes/intercepts while retaining rank two and comparable arithmetic.
Vary which row is dependent, duplicate versus nontrivial dependence, row order and required swaps/scales.
Vary whether x or y has zero free-variable coefficient, and positive/negative/zero constants; zero a12 legitimately skips a backward operation.
Correct option position and distractor error roles can change; they are incidental assignments. Preserve one correct option, not its label or its unique layout signature.
Change right-hand sides coherently to obtain a different affine solution with the same coefficient matrix; scale/reorder equations to preserve the solution.

answer_roles.role: RREF free-column entries and RHS / solution slopes and intercepts
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Answer-bearing, must follow coefficients and RHS; not fixed to source values.
Any of five locations and suitable error alternatives; cannot permit a layout cue to identify the correct choice.
